(Currently Amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer located on a first layer; a second adhesive layer located on a second layer; and a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and are aligned with each other.

(Currently Amended) Claim 290: The tool of claim 281, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are in registration with one another.

(Currently Amended) Claim 291: The tool of claim 290, wherein the ring includes a central opening.
